title: The Cow and the Stew
lines: Nick made a big pot of stew in town.
A crowd came to sit on the ground.
He had to boil it a long time.
Then a brown cow stuck its head in!
The stew spilled out on the soil.
Nick had to frown and count his coins.
But the crowd found bread, and all was good.

questions.ask: What did Nick make for the crowd?
questions.listenFor: A big pot of stew. Have them point to the first line.

questions.ask: What went wrong with the stew?
questions.listenFor: A brown cow stuck its head in and it spilled on the soil.

questions.ask: How do you think Nick felt at the end? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine. The frown and the bread both give clues.
